name: mycelium
description: Typed hierarchical workflow with durable node lineage, mandatory CAP, and external verification. The main session is STEM; APEX, SEPTUM, HYPHAE, and CAP run as plugin agents dispatched with the Agent tool.

python_executable.title: Python executable
python_executable.description: Python 3.9 or newer interpreter used by the Mycelium hooks and by evals/verify-cap.py. On Windows use python or an absolute path; do not use the python3 Microsoft Store alias.
